Article 15 GDPR entitles a data subject to obtain from a controller confirmation whether their personal data are being processed and, if so, access to those personal data and information about the processing (purposes, categories, recipients, retention, and the rights to rectification, erasure, restriction, objection, and to lodge a complaint). It also includes the right to receive a copy of the personal data and information on the data’s source and any automated decision‑making, subject to safeguards so that the copy does not adversely affect the rights and freedoms of others. ([eur-lex.europa.eu](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?qid=1494678401079&uri=CELEX%3A32016R0679&utm_source=openai))

Source: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?qid=1494678401079&uri=CELEX%3A32016R0679 (Article 15)
